meta.title: Pukalani – Your own community platform, privacy-first
meta.description: Posts, courses, events and discussions under your own brand and domain. Privacy-first, hosted in Germany, no ad tracking. The lean alternative to Circle & Skool. Start free.

hero.title: Your community. Your courses. Your rules.
hero.sub: Posts, courses, events and discussions under your own name and design. Hosted in Germany, no ad tracking. The lean, fair alternative to bloated community suites.
hero.refrain: Your place, where the sun breaks through.

problem.title: A real community should belong to you – not to someone else's network.
problem.lead: Circle, Skool and Mighty Networks are powerful – but for small communities often expensive and heavier than you need. Self-hosted forums like Discourse save money but cost you server ops and headaches. Pukalani is the lean middle path: a complete community platform you start without hassle, fully under your brand – with a transparent, predictable price.

rows.gain: Fair, predictable price. Free to start.
Hosted in Germany, no ad tracking.
Modular: switch on only what you need.

items.title: Sign up
items.text: Email is enough, log in with a code – no password required.

items.title: Pick your blocks
items.text: Turn feed, courses, events and discussions on or off. Add your design. Done.

blocks.title: One platform, many blocks. You decide which.
blocks.lead: Every block can be switched on or off. No ballast.

items.title: Discussions
items.text: Real-time comments with nested threads, votes, {'@'}-mentions and live presence – under any content.

items.title: Moderation
items.text: Reporting, two-phase hiding, AI assistance as a second opinion – the human decides.

items.title: Pages & branding
items.text: Your own pages, 26 colour worlds, custom fonts – your community looks like you.

items.title: Posts & feed
items.text: Member posts in Markdown, polls and questions, a chronological activity feed.

items.title: Courses
items.text: Lessons with progress, access free/members/pro – paid access via Stripe.

items.title: Events
items.text: Online or in person, single or recurring, with RSVPs and tickets – even embeddable.

modular.title: Take only what you need.
modular.lead: Just selling courses? Turn on courses. Community around it? Add feed and discussions. Events? One click. With Pukalani the platform grows with you, instead of burying you in features you never open.

privacy.title: Privacy is the standard here – not the upgrade.
privacy.lead: Your community data lives in Germany, not in some far-away cloud. No ad tracking, no reselling – data-minimal by design.

points.text: No ad tracking, no ads, no data selling

privacy.note: What matters in the end is your site's actual configuration and your legal texts – we deliberately avoid blanket promises.

pricing.title: One fair price for your whole community – not per block.
pricing.lead: Currently in early access, by invitation. Start free, cancel anytime, data export included.

plans.name: Free
plans.desc: To get started – one community, fair limits, the core blocks.

plans.name: Pro
plans.desc: For growing communities – more blocks (feed, events), higher limits, a small team.

plans.name: Business
plans.desc: For pros – all blocks incl. courses, custom domain, webhooks/API, unlimited seats.

pricing.silo: Your own instance + your own domain (community.yourcompany.com)? Talk to us.
pricing.numbersNote: Concrete numbers come with the public launch.

faq.title: Questions? Here are the most common ones.

items.a: In Germany, at Hetzner. No ad tracking, no reselling. Export and deletion are available anytime.

items.q: Can I keep my existing site?
items.a: Yes. Your community runs under your name and design; individual blocks like discussions can even be embedded into your existing website.
Getting started is free. Pro and Business arrive with the public launch; right now there's an early access by invitation.
Yes. No minimum term, and you take your data with you via export.
Starting with German and English; more languages will follow.

items.q: Do I have to use all blocks?
items.a: No – every block can be switched on or off. Start lean and add what you need.

story.title: A hole in the clouds.
story.intro: Far out in the Pacific lies Maui. High on the slopes of Haleakalā is a place called Pukalani. Its name is understood as an opening to the sky — a puka in the grey where light breaks through. That's where the idea for this platform was born.

strands.title: The hole in the clouds.
strands.text: Today's web is mostly clouded – full of tracking, ads, noise and closed networks where your community never truly belongs to you. Pukalani is the opening where the sun breaks through: a clear, calm place, without all the grey.

strands.title: The gateway to the sky.
strands.text: Puka and lani can be read as “an opening to the sky” — a door. And that's how the beginning should feel: you step through, and in sixty seconds your own community stands – no servers, no manual, no detours.

strands.title: Fertile ground.
strands.text: Pukalani sits in the highlands, on rich volcanic soil where things have grown for generations. That's our promise: a place where your community grows – your posts, your courses, your events, your people.

strands.title: A world of its own.
strands.text: Your community here is its own living world — sovereign, and entirely yours. It doesn't fade into someone else's network. What you build here belongs to you.

story.outro: Built by someone who wanted this platform to exist: honest, lean, privacy-first – without turning you or your members into the product. Pukalani is a special place. Pukalani.app is meant to be one too.

cta.title: Ready for your own community?
cta.lead: Step through the door – your community stands in 60 seconds. Free, no risk.
